title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 17
subtitle: Flour Baby, Part 1
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 17: Flour Baby, Part 1 (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, Pete, I have a new assignment for you – a show on single parents! What is it like for a mother or a father to raise a child by herself or himself?
dialogue.zh: 安娜、皮特，我给你们一个新任务——做一期关于单亲父母的节目！一位母亲或父亲独自抚养孩子是什么样的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can interview single parents. They can share their experiences themselves.
dialogue.zh: 我们可以采访单亲父母。他们可以亲自分享自己的经历。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, but you need to experience parenthood yourselves.
dialogue.zh: 可以，可你们得自己体验一下为人父母。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ourselves?
dialogue.zh: 我们自己？

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Yeah, how do we do that? We’re not parents.
dialogue.zh: 对啊，怎么体验？我们又不是父母。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I asked myself the same question. I said, “Caty, how are they gonna do that?” Then an idea came to me. I will give you the babies!
dialogue.zh: 我也问过自己同样的问题。我说：“凯蒂，他们要怎么做到？”然后我有了主意。我把宝宝给你们！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: You may be asking yourself the same thing that I’m asking myself: what is Ms. Weaver talking about!? I am sure we will find out shortly. This lesson teaches reflexive pronouns. Reflexive pronouns refer back to the subject of a sentence or clause. We use them when the subject and the object are the same person or thing. For example, Ms. Weaver says, “I asked myself the same question.” “I” is the subject and “myself” refers back to it. Here, she would not use the pronoun “me.” You need to use the reflexive pronoun “myself.” Reflexive pronouns are easy to find: they end in “self” or “selves.” I have a feeling we are going to see a lot of reflexive pronouns. Listen for them!
dialogue.zh: 你可能也在问自己我在问的问题：韦弗女士在说什么！？我们很快就会知道。这一课教反身代词。反身代词回指句子或从句的主语。当主语和宾语是同一个人或事物时使用。比如韦弗女士说：“I asked myself the same question.” I 是主语，myself 回指它。这里不能用 me，要用反身代词 myself。反身代词很好找：以 self 或 selves 结尾。我感觉我们会听到很多反身代词。注意听！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Here are your babies!
dialogue.zh: 这是你们的宝宝！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Those are bags of flour.
dialogue.zh: 那是几袋面粉。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: No, Pete, for the next six days, this is your baby. Here are your instructions. Do not leave your babies alone. A baby cannot take care of itself. And you two must do everything by yourselves. We will meet next Friday. Oh, and the person who does the best research will get an extra day of vacation. Help yourself to a baby.
dialogue.zh: 不，皮特，接下来六天，这就是你的宝宝。这是你们的说明。不要把宝宝单独留下。宝宝不能照顾自己。你们两个必须自己做所有事。下周五见面。哦，研究做得最好的人会多得一天假期。自己选一个宝宝吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pete, look, my baby is organic and whole grain. Your baby is ordinary.
dialogue.zh: 皮特，看，我的宝宝是有机全麦的。你的宝宝很普通。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Monster! This is a great idea, Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 怪物！这主意太棒了，韦弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: This is a terrible idea.
dialogue.zh: 这主意糟透了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Speak for yourself, Pete! We need to throw ourselves into the research! I’m starting right now!
dialogue.zh: 那是你自己的想法，皮特！我们得全身心投入研究！我现在就开始！

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.en: Hey Anna, you forgot your baby!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜，你忘了你的宝宝！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come to mama!
dialogue.zh: 到妈妈这儿来！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good girl! Good girl!
dialogue.zh: 好姑娘！好姑娘！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Singular reflexive pronouns end in “self.” Plural ones end in “selves.” Anna says, “We need to throw ourselves into the research!” The subject “we” is plural. So, we must use the plural reflexive pronoun “ourselves.”
dialogue.zh: 单数反身代词以 self 结尾。复数以 selves 结尾。安娜说：“We need to throw ourselves into the research!” 主语 we 是复数，所以必须用复数反身代词 ourselves。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is hard! I hope Pete is not doing well. I really need that vacation day!
dialogue.zh: 好难！希望皮特做得不好。我真的需要那天假期！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: We will all see how Pete is doing in the next episode. We’ll also learn when not to use reflexive pronouns.
dialogue.zh: 下一集我们会看到皮特做得怎么样。我们也会学什么时候不用反身代词。

quiz.prompt: What new assignment does Ms. Weaver give Anna and Pete?
What are the "babies" Ms. Weaver gives them?
What does the person with the best research get?
